blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent 3D generation models can produce accurate geometries while still struggling to reconstruct detailed textures. We propose a diffusion-based native 3D material generation model TaoTex, which faithfully recovers intricate textures through tailored strategies and improvements.
First, we develop a data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets to bridge the data gap in public datasets. Training with these data significantly enhances the ability of TaoTex to recover challenging details such as text and patterns. Second, we design a multi-level feature fusion (MLFF) module to adaptively integrate local and global features of the conditional input, providing more complete texture cues for the diffusion model and thereby enhancing reconstruction fidelity. To alleviate VAE reconstruction errors, we adopt a latent-to-pixel space loss transition, further improving the pixel-level details and generation quality. Finally, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, achieving accurate and consistent material reconstruction across views. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing approaches in preserving texture details in both single- and multi-view settings.
blocks.zh:
最近的3D生成模型可以产生准确的几何图案,同时仍然在努力重建详细的纹理. 我们提出一种基于扩散的本地立体材料生成模型TaoTex,通过量身定制的战略和改进,忠实地恢复复杂的纹理。
一,开发数据构建代理 打造高频文本化3D资产 弥补公共数据集数据空白. 使用这些数据的培训大大提高了TaoTex恢复文本和模式等具有挑战性的细节的能力. 第二,我们设计了一个多层次的特性聚变模块,以适应性地整合有条件输入的局部和全球特征,为扩散模型提供更完整的纹理提示,从而增强重建忠心. 为了缓解VAE重建错误,我们采用了潜在到像素空间损失的过渡,进一步改善像素级的细节和生成质量. 最后,我们通过纳入可学习的观点嵌入,实现准确和一致的跨观点物质重建,将TaoTex扩大到多视图输入。 广泛的实验表明,我们的方法在保存单视图和多视图环境的纹理细节方面大大超过现有方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Diffusion-based Image-to-3D asset generation ( Chang et al., 2026 ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2024 ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a ; Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) has advanced rapidly, yet existing methods struggle to faithfully reconstruct complex textures on 3D surfaces from input images, restricting their applicability to objects with simple textures rather than texture-rich categories. Current methods for generating materials on 3D assets typically operate either in view-space ( Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; He et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ) or directly in 3D-space ( Lai et al., 2026 ; Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ; Chang et al., 2026 ) . While view-space methods can leverage the priors of image generation models to assist texture synthesis, they still suffer from significant limitations. For example, texture baking may produce ghosting in overlapping regions, self-occluded areas require additional UV-space inpainting, and texture-geometry misalignment can cause projection artifacts. In contrast, generating material properties in 3D space inherently ensures global consistency and avoids the issue of self-occlusion.
blocks.zh: 基于扩散的图像到3D资产生成(Chan等人,2026年;Hunyuan3D) 团队,2024年;Hunyuan3D 团队,2025b;Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a; Xiang et al., 2024; Xiang et al., 2026) 进展迅速,然而,现有的方法却从输入图像上在3D表面忠实地重建复杂的纹理,限制其适用于纹理简单而非纹理丰富的类物体. 目前以3D资产生成材料的方法通常在景区运作(Hunyuan3D Team,2025a;Hunyuan3D) Team,2025b;He等人,2025;Wu等人,2026;Huang等人,2025;Zhang等人,2026;Liang等人,2026;Han等人,2026)或直接在3D空间(Lai等人,2026;Xiang等人,2024;Xiang等人,2026;Chang等人,2026). 虽然视图空间方法可以利用图像生成模型的前身来协助纹理合成,但它们仍然受到很大限制. 例如,纹理烘焙可能在重叠区域产生幽灵,自闭区域需要额外的紫外空间涂层,纹理几何错位可能导致投影文物. 相比之下,在3D空间生成物质属性本身就确保了全球一致性,避免了自我隔离的问题.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Texture generation and geometric cues. In the green box, geometric variations align well with texture changes, effectively guiding appearance generation. Conversely, the red box contains feature-sparse surfaces where geometry provides little guidance for synthesizing patterns and text.
blocks.zh: 图 2:纹理生成和几何提示. 在绿框中,几何变化与纹理变化很吻合,有效引导外观生成. 反之,红盒中包含特征-散射表面,其中几何为合成图案和文字提供了很少的指导.

blocks.en: However, existing 3D-space methods often fail to generate accurate patterns on planar or smooth surfaces. These regions lack distinctive geometric cues for the model to match with the conditional images, leading to incorrect or fragmented textures ( Fig. 2 ). We attribute this limitation to three factors: 1) Current public 3D datasets provide insufficient high-frequency textures, leaving the mapping from intricate patterns to simple surfaces unexplored by the model. 2) Conditional image features are semantically biased and lack detailed information. 3) Latent-space training is bounded by the reconstruction accuracy of the 3D VAE. Moreover, these methods either do not support multi-view input or perform poorly on it, despite its necessity in practical applications.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的3D-空间方法往往无法在平面或平滑表面产生准确的图案. 这些地区缺乏独特的几何提示,使模型与有条件的图像相匹配,导致纹理不正确或支离破碎(图2)。 我们将此限制归因于三个因素: 1)当前公共3D数据集提供的高频纹理不足,使得绘图从复杂图案到简单的表面没有被模型所探索. 2)有条件的图像特征带有刻板偏见,缺乏详细信息. 3) 梯队空间训练以3D VAE的重建精度为界. 此外,这些方法要么不支持多视图输入,要么在实际应用中表现不佳。

blocks.en: To address these issues, we propose TaoTex, a native material generation model with the capability to recover texture details from both single-view and multi-view inputs. For training this model, we develop a 3D asset data construction agent based on the Qwen LLM ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , which enables the automatic creation of diverse 3D assets with detailed text, logo patterns, and various material properties. To better capture fine details from the conditional images, we propose a Multi-level Feature Fusion (MLFF) module that adaptively integrates both semantic and local information, allowing a more faithful reconstruction. To mitigate the accuracy degradation caused by the 3D VAE, we use a two-stage training strategy, starting with latent-space loss and then switching to pixel-space loss. Furthermore, we scale TaoTex to multi-view inputs by introducing learnable viewpoint embeddings. Combined with our constructed dataset and trained with a low-SNR schedule, this enables accurate and consistent texture reconstruction across different views.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用TaoTex这一本土材料生成模型,能够从单视图和多视图输入中恢复纹理细节。 为了培训这一模式,我们开发了一个基于Quen LLM(Quen Team, 2026)的3D资产数据构建代理,它使得能够自动创建各种3D资产,并具有详细的文本,标志模式,以及各种物质属性. 为了更好地从有条件的图像中捕捉精细的细节,我们提出一个多层次的特异性融合(MLFF)模块,适应性地将语义信息和当地信息融合起来,从而能够进行更加忠实的重建. 为了缓解3D VAE导致的精度退化,我们采用了两阶段的训练策略,从潜在空间损失开始,然后切换到像素空间损失. 此外,我们通过引入可学习的观点嵌入,将TaoTex扩大到多视图输入。 这与我们已建的数据集相结合,并经过了低度SNR时间表的培训,从而能够在不同观点中进行准确和连贯的纹理重建。

blocks.en: The primary contributions of this work are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • Design a novel data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets for training, boosting the ability of the native 3D material generation model to handle patterns and text. • Propose the MLFF module, coupled with the latent-to-pixel space loss transition strategy, enabling TaoTex to reconstruct higher-fidelity texture details from the input images. • Develop a training strategy for multi-view reconstruction, incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, symmetric geometry data, and a low-SNR schedule, which enables TaoTex to support both single- and multi-view inputs while achieving globally consistent and seamless texture reconstruction via a generation framework that outperforms existing leading methods.
blocks.zh: • 设计一个新的数据构建代理,为培训创造高频文本化3D资产,提高本地3D材料生成模型处理模式和文本的能力。 • 提出MLFF模块,加上潜在到像素的空间损失过渡战略,使TaoTex能够从输入图像中重建更真实的纹理细节。 • 制定多视图重建培训战略,纳入可学习的观点嵌入、对称几何数据和低SNR时间表,使TaoTex能够支持单视图和多视图输入,同时通过超越现有主要方法的一代框架实现全球一致和无缝纹理重建。

blocks.en: Design a novel data construction agent to create high-frequency textured 3D assets for training, boosting the ability of the native 3D material generation model to handle patterns and text.
blocks.zh: 设计新的数据构建代理,为培训创造高频纹理3D资产,提升本土3D材料生成模型处理模式和文本的能力.

blocks.en: Propose the MLFF module, coupled with the latent-to-pixel space loss transition strategy, enabling TaoTex to reconstruct higher-fidelity texture details from the input images.
blocks.zh: 提出 MLFF 模块,加上潜在到像素的空间损失过渡策略,使 TaoTex 能够从输入图像中重建更真实的纹理细节.

blocks.en: Develop a training strategy for multi-view reconstruction, incorporating learnable viewpoint embeddings, symmetric geometry data, and a low-SNR schedule, which enables TaoTex to support both single- and multi-view inputs while achieving globally consistent and seamless texture reconstruction via a generation framework that outperforms existing leading methods.
blocks.zh: 制定多视图重建培训战略,纳入可学习的观点嵌入、对称几何数据和低SNR时间表,使TaoTex能够支持单视图和多视图输入,同时通过超越现有主要方法的一代框架实现全球一致和无缝的纹理重建。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 View-Space Texture Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 视图空间纹理生成

blocks.en: Leveraging 2D diffusion priors ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , early methods optimize surface appearance via Score Distillation Sampling (SDS) ( Poole et al., 2022 ; Chen et al., 2023b ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) , which is computationally expensive and prone to over-saturation and Janus artifacts. To improve efficiency, TEXTure ( Richardson et al., 2023 ) and Text2Tex ( Chen et al., 2023a ) sequentially synthesize and project individual views onto meshes, but their view-by-view pipeline lacks direct cross-view interaction, accumulating inconsistencies across viewpoints.
blocks.zh: 利用2D扩散前科(Rombach等人,2022年),早期方法通过分数分馏取样(SDS)优化表面外观(Poole等人,2022年;Chen等人,2023年b;Lin等人,2023年;Liang等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年),计算费用昂贵,容易过度饱和和和及Janus文物. 为了提高效率,TEXTure(Richardson等人,2023年)和Text2Tex(Chen等人,2023年a年)相继合成个人观点,并将个人观点投射到 meshes上,但他们的逐景管道缺乏直接的交叉视图互动,积累了不同观点的不一致.

blocks.en:
Recent methods adopt multi-view diffusion (MVD) to improve cross-view consistency ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Shi et al., 2023 ; Long et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) . Subsequent works improve texture quality through synchronized denoising, geometric conditioning, cross-view attention, and specialized projection strategies ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Zeng et al., 2024 ; Cheng et al., 2025 ; Bensadoun et al., 2024 ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025a ; Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . In parallel, Ink3D ( Han et al., 2026 ) employs video diffusion for continuous orbit-scan coverage. Other recent methods extend view-space synthesis from RGB appearances to PBR material properties, including albedo, roughness, and metallic ( He et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
Despite substantial progress, view-space methods still suffer from cross-view inconsistencies in high-frequency regions, incomplete coverage under self-occlusion, and projection artifacts along depth boundaries.
blocks.zh:
近代方法采用多视角传播(MVD),以提高交叉视角的一致性(Liu等人,2023年;Shi等人,2023年;Long等人,2024年;Li等人,2024年). 随后的作品通过同步解析,几何调节,交叉视线关注,以及专业投影策略,提高了纹理质量(刘等人,2024年b;曾等人,2024年;程等人,2025年;本萨多恩等人,2024年;洪云3D). 团队,2025a;Hunyuan3D Team, 2025b; 刘等人, 2026 ). 并行的墨水3D (Han等人,2026年)利用视频传播进行连续轨道扫描覆盖。 其他近代方法将视距空间合成从RGB外观延伸至PBR物质属性,包括反照率,粗糙度和金属(He等人,2025年;Huang等人,2025年;Wu等人,2026年).
尽管取得了很大进展,但视野空间方法在高频地区仍然存在着交叉视差,自我隔离的覆盖范围不完整,以及沿着深度边界投射文物。

blocks.en: 2.2 Native 3D Texture Generation
blocks.zh: 2.2 原始3D纹理生成

blocks.en: Native 3D methods model appearance directly in geometry-aligned spaces. Early works synthesize per-face colors using adversarial objectives ( Siddiqui et al., 2022 ) or continuous implicit fields ( Oechsle et al., 2019 ) . Modern diffusion-based approaches investigate varied representations, including colored point clouds, octree grids, UV parameterizations, and 3D Gaussian attributes ( Yu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2024a ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2025 ) , each presenting trade-offs between resolution, efficiency, and graphics compatibility. Concurrently, unified frameworks generate geometry and texture jointly ( Hong et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2024 ) , though their structural coupling restricts independent texture optimization.
blocks.zh: 原生的3D方法模型直接出现在几何对齐空间中. 早期作品采用对抗目标(Siddiqui等人,2022年)或连续隐含字段(Oechsle等人,2019年)合成面色. 现代传播法调查了各种表达方式,包括彩色点云、octree网格、紫外线参数化和3D Gaussian属性(Yu等人,2023年;Liu等人,2024年a; Yu et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2025 ),分别呈现分辨率,效率和图形兼容性之间的权衡. 同时,统一的框架共同产生几何和纹理(Hong等人,2023年;Tang等人,2024年),尽管其结构耦合限制了独立的纹理优化.

blocks.en: More recently, structured latent spaces have established a powerful foundation for native 3D appearance modeling. Pioneered by Trellis ( Xiang et al., 2024 ; Xiang et al., 2026 ) , geometry and texture can be jointly parameterized within a unified Structured LATent (SLAT) manifold. Targeting texture synthesis on fixed shapes, NaTex ( Lai et al., 2026 ) introduces an explicit decoupling of geometric structure and surface color using a dual-stream autoencoder enriched with cross-latent feature aggregation. Building upon spatial sparsity and coordinate continuity, recent approaches perform diffusion on sparse voxel features or topology-agnostic texture formulations ( Zeng et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) , expanding the generative scope from raw radiance to complete physically based material channels ( Yeo et al., 2026 ) . While 3D-space methods effectively ensure global consistency and seamless surface coverage, existing frameworks fall short of resolving sharp, high-frequency appearance details.
blocks.zh: 最近,结构化的潜在空间为本地立体外观模型的建立奠定了坚实的基础。 由Trellis(Xiang et al., 2024; Xiang et al., 2026)担任先锋,几何学和纹理可以在统一的结构LATent(SLAT)倍数内联合参数化. 瞄准固定形状的纹理合成,NaTex(Lai等人,2026年)采用富含跨纬度特征聚合的双流自动编码器,引入了几何结构与表面颜色的明确脱钩. 在空间伸缩和协调连续性的基础上,最近的方法对稀少的阴道特征或地形-不可知纹理配体进行扩散(Zeng等人,2026年;Liang等人,2026年),将基因范围从原始辐射扩大到完成物理物质渠道(Yeo等人,2026年)。 虽然三维空间方法有效地确保了全球一致性和无缝的表面覆盖,但现有的框架还不能解决尖锐的高频外观细节。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: TaoTex is a native 3D generative model based on the o-voxel representation ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , producing PBR materials (albedo, roughness, and metallic) from an input geometry and one or multiple images. Below, we present our data construction agent ( Sec. 3.1 ), key improvements for boosting texture details ( Sec. 3.2 ), and the extension of this backbone to multi-view setting ( Sec. 3.3 ).
blocks.zh: TaoTex是一种基于o-voxel代表物(Xiang等人,2026年)的原生3D基因模型,从输入几何和一个或多个图像中生成PBR材料(albedo,粗糙度和金属度). 下面,我们介绍我们的数据构建代理(第3.1节),增强纹理细节的关键改进(第3.2节),以及将这一主干扩展到多视图设置(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Method overview. We advance native 3D material detail reconstruction across three fronts: a data agent for high-frequency asset curation, an MLFF module fusing multi-scale features, and a pixel-space loss countering latent compression. Coupled with learnable viewpoint embeddings, TaoTex robustly supports both single- and multi-view inputs.
blocks.zh: 图3:方法概览。 我们从三个方面推进本地3D物质细节重建:高频资产调节数据代理、MLFF模块引信多尺度特性,以及抵御潜在压缩的像素空间损失。 TaoTex与可学习的观点嵌入法相结合,有力支持单视图和多视图输入。

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Construction Agent
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据构建 探员

blocks.en: We prompt a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to produce Blender scripts that generate target meshes ( Fig. 3 ). The candidate mesh is then rendered and visually critiqued by the MLLM to guide iterative code refinement, with an iteration cap enforced to control runtime. Once approved, the constructed geometry undergoes automated UV unwrapping. Owing to the simple topologies of our target geometries such as cans, cups and boxes, this pipeline is able to autonomously produce meshes with well-structured UV layouts, which is essential for subsequent texture generation.
blocks.zh: 我们鼓励一种多式大语言模型(MLLM)来生成Blender脚本,生成目标 meshes(图3). 之后,MLLM对候选网格进行渲染和视觉批评,以指导迭代代码的完善,并强制使用迭代封顶来控制运行时间. 一旦批准,所建造的几何系统将进行自动紫外线解围。 由于我们的目标几何美图的地形简单,如罐子,杯子和盒子,这种管道能够自主地生产布局井然有序的紫外线布局,这对后来的纹理生成至关重要.

blocks.en: The UV layout mask acts as a spatial condition for an Image Generation Model (IGM) to synthesize textures in the UV domain, tasked with producing detailed text and patterns ( Fig. 3 ). To prevent perceptual artifacts, the MLLM evaluates the texture map by checking pattern sharpness and boundary alignment against the UV layout. The verified texture is bound to the geometric mesh alongside MLLM-prescribed PBR parameters (roughness and metallic), which yields high-frequency textured (HFT) 3D assets.
blocks.zh: 紫外线布局遮罩作为图像生成模型(IGM)合成紫外线域纹理的空间条件,负责制作详细的文字和图案(图3). 为防止知觉文物,MLLM通过对照紫外线布局检查图案的锐度和边界对齐度来评价纹理图. 经核实的纹理与MLLM规定的PBR参数(光度和金属)并列,可产生高频纹理(HFT)3D资产。

blocks.en: We employ Qwen-3.8 as the MLLM and Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) as the IGM. Although our agent natively supports end-to-end construction, in practice we prioritize efficiency: we first produce a fixed set of category-specific meshes, and subsequently synthesize a large volume of diverse textures over their UV layouts. This choice is driven by the fact that our task demands far greater texture diversity than geometric diversity. Constrained by the capabilities of current IGM models, the synthesized textures may not align flawlessly with the given UV layouts, but this discrepancy does not compromise the training of TaoTex in any manner.
blocks.zh: 我们雇用Quen-3.8作为MLLM,Quen-Image-3.0-Pro(Quen Team,2026)作为IGM. 虽然我们的代理人在本土上支持端到端的构造,但实际上我们优先考虑效率:我们首先生产一套固定的类别特定网格,然后在他们的紫外线布局上合成大量不同的纹理. 这一选择的驱动力是,我们的任务要求的纹理多样性远远超过几何多样性。 受当前IGM模型能力的限制,合成的纹理可能不会与给定的紫外线布局完美一致,但这种差异不会以任何方式影响TaoTex的训练.

blocks.en: 3.2 Detail Preservation Scheme
blocks.zh: 3.2 详细保管计划

blocks.en: Using HFT data together with public datasets, we train a DiT model ℱ θ \mathcal{F}_{\theta} to recover PBR materials from a given image C C and geometry 𝒢 \mathcal{G} with v-parameterization ( Salimans and Ho, 2022 ) : ℒ θ = 𝔼 ​ ‖ ℱ θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , t , 𝐳 c , 𝐳 𝒢 ) − 𝐯 ‖ 2 2 , \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\theta}=\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathcal{F}_{\theta}\Bigl(\mathbf{x}_{t},t,\mathbf{z}_{c},\mathbf{z}_{\mathcal{G}}\Bigr)-\mathbf{v}\right\|_{2}^{2}, (1) where 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} is the latent feature at step t t , and 𝐳 𝒢 \mathbf{z}_{\mathcal{G}} is the geometry latent from a pretrained encoder ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) . As deep semantic features 𝐳 c = ℰ ⁡ ( C ) \mathbf{z}_{c}=\mathcal{E}(C) via DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) fail to retain details ( Fig. 4 ), we design an MLFF module to overcome this.
blocks.zh: 使用HFT数据与公共数据集一起,我们训练一个DiT模型F \ mathcal{F}_{\theta}从给定的图像C和几何G \ mathcal{G}中回收PBR材料,使用v-参数化(Salimans和Ho,2022年) Lθ=E‖Fθ(x t, t, t, z c, z G) → v‖ 2,\dislaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\theta}=\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathcal{F}_{\T}_{\T}\2}), (1) 其中x t\ mathbf{x}_{t}为步骤 t t 的潜伏特征,z G\mathbf{z}_{\mathcal{G}}}为预训编码器的几何潜伏特征(Xiang等人,2026年). 由于深层语义特征 z c = E ⁡ (C)\mathbf{zc}=\ mathcal{E}(C)通过 DINov2(Oquab et al., 2024) 未能保留细节(图4),我们设计了一个MLFF模块来克服这一点.

blocks.en: We extract DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) features { ℰ ( l ) ​ ( C ) } l = 1 L \{\mathcal{E}^{(l)}(C)\}_{l=1}^{L} across L L layers spanning both shallow and deep levels from the image C C . These features are aggregated into a single representation via ℳ ϕ \mathcal{M}_{\phi} and jointly optimized with the denoiser ℱ θ \mathcal{F}_{\theta} : ℒ θ , ϕ = 𝔼 ​ ‖ ℱ θ ​ ( 𝐱 t , t , ℳ ϕ ​ ( { ℰ ( l ) ​ ( C ) } l = 1 L ) , 𝐳 𝒢 ) − 𝐯 ‖ 2 2 . \mathcal{L}_{\theta,\phi}=\mathbb{E}\left\|\mathcal{F}_{\theta}\Bigl(\mathbf{x}_{t},t,\mathcal{M}_{\phi}\bigl(\{\mathcal{E}^{(l)}(C)\}_{l=1}^{L}\bigr),\mathbf{z}_{\mathcal{G}}\Bigr)-\mathbf{v}\right\|_{2}^{2}. (2)

We select L = 4 L=4 layers (the 4th, 11th, 17th, and 23rd), which empirically suffices to recover diverse texture details. Furthermore, to enhance the spatial awareness of the fused representations, we augment them with learnable patch-level positional embeddings.
blocks.zh: 我们选择L = 4 L = 4 层(第四层,第十一层,第十七层,第二十三层),从经验上看,这足以恢复各种不同的纹理细节. 此外,为了增强对引信表示的空间意识,我们用可学习的补丁级定位嵌入器加以扩充。

blocks.en:
Although computationally efficient, latent-space training inevitably incurs fidelity loss from compression artifacts (see w/o pixel space loss in Fig. 4 ). To counter this, we introduce a coarse-to-fine supervision strategy that transitions to pixel space in late training stages. Formally, the predicted 𝐯 ^ \hat{\mathbf{v}} is mapped back to 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} and decoded into a PBR mesh, which is rendered into pixel-space albedo, roughness, and metallic maps across different viewpoints to provide multi-view photometric supervision: ℒ θ , ϕ ∗ = 1 K ​ ∑ i = 1 K ( λ 1 ​ ℒ L1 ( i ) + λ 2 ​ ℒ SSIM ( i ) + λ 3 ​ ℒ LPIPS ( i ) ) , \mathcal{L}_{\theta,\phi}^{*}=\frac{1}{K}\sum_{i=1}^{K}\left(\lambda_{1}\mathcal{L}_{\text{L1}}^{(i)}+\lambda_{2}\mathcal{L}_{\text{SSIM}}^{(i)}+\lambda_{3}\mathcal{L}_{\text{LPIPS}}^{(i)}\right), (3) where K K indicates the number of viewpoints under supervision. ℒ SSIM \mathcal{L}_{\text{SSIM}} denotes the structural similarity loss ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and ℒ LPIPS \mathcal{L}_{\text{LPIPS}} denotes the learned perceptual loss ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) .
To preserve reconstruction capability, we supervise the views rendered from the same viewpoints as the input images with weights set to ( λ 1 , λ 2 , λ 3 ) = ( 1.0 , 0.2 , 0.2 ) (\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2},\lambda_{3})=(1.0,0.2,0.2) , favoring high photometric fidelity. Meanwhile, we render 2 novel viewpoints and adjust the weights to ( 0.2 , 0.2 , 1.0 ) (0.2,0.2,1.0) to enhance generative quality, emphasizing global perceptual realism over rigid per-pixel alignment.
blocks.zh:
虽然计算效率高,但潜在的空间培训不可避免地会因压缩文物而丧失忠诚(见图4中的w/o像素空间损失)。 为了解决这一问题,我们采用了粗细至精细的监督战略,在培训后期向像素空间过渡。 形式上,预测的 v ^\ hat\ mathbf{v} 被映射回x 0\ mathbf{x×××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××××× L SSIM \ mathcal{L}_{\Text{SSIM}}表示结构相似性损失(Wang等人,2004年),LPIPS \ mathcal{L}_{\Text{LPIPS}}表示所学知觉损失(Zhang等人,2018年).
为了保持重建能力,我们监督从与输入图像相同的角度表达的观点,这些图像的重量设定为(λ 1,λ 2,λ 3) = (1.0, 0.2, 0.2) = (\lambda_{1},\lambda_{2},\lambda_{3}) = (1.0, 0.2, 0.2), 倾向于高光度的忠诚度。 与此同时,我们提出两个新观点,并将权重调整到(0.2、0.2、1.0),以提高基因质量,强调全球观念现实主义,而不是僵硬的每像素比对。

blocks.en: 3.3 Multi-View Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.3 多维重建

blocks.en:
Incorporating inputs from additional viewpoints provides an alternative path to enhance texture fidelity. However, existing methods either lack native support for multi-view inputs or yield suboptimal results when generalized to this setting. To scale our pipeline to multi-view inputs, a straightforward approach is to concatenate the visual tokens of all input views before feeding them into ℱ θ \mathcal{F}_{\theta} . Nevertheless, the expanded token sequence exacerbates the difficulty of image-to-geometry feature alignment, leading to fragmented or incorrect texture generation ( Fig. 5 ).
We address this issue through a simple yet effective strategy: adding a learnable viewpoint embedding to the features of each view to disambiguate tokens originating from different viewpoints. These embeddings are jointly optimized with ℱ θ \mathcal{F}_{\theta} and ℳ ϕ \mathcal{M}_{\phi} to ensure seamless integration, and remain fixed during inference. Our model accommodates up to four input views, which proves sufficient for the vast majority of objects. These viewpoint embeddings correspond to canonical front, back, left, and right positions, covering a 90-degree horizontal range and a 180-degree vertical elevation range.
blocks.zh:
纳入来自其他观点的投入,为加强纹理的忠实性提供了另一种途径。 然而,现有方法要么缺乏对多视图投入的本能支持,要么在普遍采用这种环境时产生不理想的结果。 为了把我们的管道扩大为多视图输入,一个直接的方法是将所有输入视图的视觉符号组合起来,然后输入F\\ mathcal{F\theta}。 尽管如此,扩大的代号序列加剧了图像到几何特征对齐的难度,导致纹理生成支离破碎或不正确(图5).
我们通过一个简单而有效的战略来解决这一问题:在每种观点的特征中加入一个可学习的观点,以分散来自不同观点的标志。 这些嵌入物与F \\ mathcal{F}_{\theta}和M \ mathcal{M}_{\phi}共同优化,以确保无缝融合,并在推论中保持固定. 我们的模型可容纳最多四个输入视图,这足以满足绝大多数对象的需要。 这些观点嵌入对应于犬形前方,后方,左方和右方的位置,覆盖90度水平范围,180度垂直高程.

blocks.en: Training on the HFT dataset is critical for properly optimizing the viewpoint embeddings. We intentionally curate this dataset with an abundance of symmetric primitives like cylinders and boxes, whose geometries are nearly indistinguishable across views. This structural ambiguity prevents the model from deducing viewpoints solely from shape cues, ensuring that the viewpoint embeddings are not bypassed. Meanwhile, rich multi-view appearance details compel the model to learn seamless cross-view transitions.
blocks.zh: 关于HFT数据集的培训对于适当优化观点嵌入至关重要。 我们有意用大量像圆柱和盒子这样的对称原始数据来整理这个数据集,它们的几何图形几乎是无法辨别的。 这种结构上的模糊性使模型无法完全从形状提示中推断观点,确保观点嵌入不被绕过. 同时,丰富的多视图外观细节迫使模型学习无缝交叉视图过渡.

blocks.en: Multi-view texture reconstruction critically relies on the early denoising steps, which establish coarse texture localization before later steps refine details. This makes training near t = 1 t=1 (pure noise) essential for learning the viewpoint embeddings. Motivated by this observation, we sample timesteps from a logit-normal distribution biased toward the low-SNR regime, with a mean of 2 and a standard deviation of 1.
blocks.zh: 多视图纹理重建严重依赖于早期的去诺化步骤,这些步骤在以后的步骤完善细节之前就建立了粗质局部化. 这使得接近 t = 1 t = 1(纯噪音)的训练对学习嵌入观点至关重要。 基于这一观察,我们从偏向低SNR制度的对数正常分布中取样时间步骤,平均为2,标准偏差为1。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Effect of the HFT data, MLFF and pixel space loss. The comparisons above validate the efficacy of each proposed component. Specifically, the HFT dataset is indispensable for reconstructing text and patterns; without it, the model fails to synthesize legible text. Furthermore, the MLFF module is crucial for faithfully reproducing textures from input images, while the pixel-space loss further sharpens subtle details, notably minute characters.
blocks.zh: 图4:HFT数据的影响,MLFF和像素空间损失. 上述比较证实了每个拟议组成部分的功效。 具体来说,HFT数据集对于重建文本和模式是不可或缺的;没有它,模型就无法合成可读文本. 此外,MLFF模块对于从输入图像中忠实地复制纹理至关重要,而像素-空格的丢失则会进一步磨亮微妙的细节,特别是分钟字符.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Effect of the viewpoint embeddings. Red boxes highlight texture misplacement caused by omitting viewpoint embeddings ( e.g. , left-view textures are erroneously mapped to the back), while arrows indicate severe texture fragmentation in its absence.
blocks.zh: 图5:观点嵌入的效果。 红框突出显示因省略视角嵌入而导致的纹理错位(例如,左视图纹理被错误地映射到背面),而箭头则表示在没有时严重纹理破碎.

blocks.en: 3.4 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.4 执行细节

blocks.en: The overall training data is assembled from Objaverse-XL ( Deitke et al., 2023 ) , TexVerse ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and our HFT dataset, encompassing 500K, 300K, and 50K high-quality filtered PBR assets, respectively. Each asset is rendered across 16 viewpoints at a resolution of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 under randomized fields of view and varied environmental lighting.
blocks.zh: 总体培训数据来自Objaverse-XL(Deitke等人,2023年),TexVerse(Zhang等人,2025年)和我们的HFT数据集,分别包括500K,300K和50K高品质过滤的PBR资产. 每项资产在1024×1024 1024\times 1024的分辨率下,在随机的视野和各种环境照明下,通过16种观点提供。

blocks.en: Multi-layer DINOv2 features are projected via dedicated two-layer MLPs and concatenated along the channel dimension, followed by an SE-inspired ( Hu et al., 2018 ) channel attention gate that adaptively reweights channels via global pooling and a two-layer gated excitation MLP. The calibrated features are then compressed along the channel dimension by a three-layer fusion MLP, added to the mean residual of all projected layers, and normalized through LayerNorm, achieving efficient cross-layer feature fusion with enhanced training stability. Across all aforementioned MLPs, intermediate hidden layers consistently employ GELU activations, while the excitation module terminates with a Sigmoid function to generate attention weights.
blocks.zh: 多层DINov2特性通过专用的两层MLP投影,沿通道维度进行凸起,随后是SE启发式(Hu等人,2018年)的信道注意门,通过全球集合和双层门激动式MLP对频道进行适应性重压. 然后通过三层聚变MLP将校准的特性沿通道维度压缩,加入所有投射层的平均残基,并通过LayerNorm实现正常化,实现高效的跨层聚变,增强训练稳定性. 在上述所有MLP中,中间隐藏层始终采用GELU激活,而激发模块则以Sigmoid函数终止,以产生注意力权重.

blocks.en: We fine-tune the material SC-VAE ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) on our dataset using 16 NVIDIA H20 GPUs (total batch size 64). Freezing the fine-tuned VAE, we train the DiT and the remaining modules under the same setup with a batch size of 16, using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . Training spans two 100K-step phases: first optimizing strictly with the latent-space loss, then continuing with the pixel-space loss, while alternating between single-view and multi-view inputs throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们使用16个NVIDIA H20 GPU(总批量尺寸64),在我们的数据集上微调材料SC-VAE(Xiang等人,2026年)。 冻结微调的VAE,我们使用 AdamW(Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017) 的分批大小为16的DiT和其余模块在同一设置下进行训练,学习率为 1×10−4 1\times 10\-4}. 培训跨越两个100K步阶段:首先严格优化潜在空间损失,然后继续像素空间损失,同时在整个过程中在单视图和多视图输入之间交替进行。

blocks.zh: 表1:单一观点投入下的数量比较。 粗体:最好,下划线:第二好。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We compare TaoTex with existing SOTA methods for evaluation. In the single-view setting, we compare against TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) , a 3D generation method, as well as view-space methods including UniTEX ( Liang et al., 2026 ) , Ink3D ( Han et al., 2026 ) , and MaterialMVP ( He et al., 2025 ) . In the multi-view setting, we compare against TRELLIS.2, MaterialMVP, and ReconViaGen ( Chang et al., 2026 ) , as the remaining baselines support only single-image conditioning. For TRELLIS.2, we implement the multi-view mode by switching the conditioning view during denoising, following TRELLIS ( Xiang et al., 2024 ) . To ensure a fair comparison of material generation, all methods use GT geometry except ReconViaGen, which cannot incorporate geometric input; therefore, we provide only qualitative comparisons for ReconViaGen. We also present qualitative comparisons with industry-leading commercial models.
blocks.zh: 我们比较TaoTex和现有的SOTA评估方法. 在单视图设定中,我们比较了TRELLIS2(Xiang等人,2026年),一种3D生成方法,以及包括Unitex(Liang等人,2026年),Ink3D在内的视图空间方法. (Han等人,2026年),和物质MVP. (He等人,2025年). 在多视图设定中,我们与TRELLIS.2, MaterialMVP, 以及ReconViaGen(Chang等人, 2026年)作比较,作为剩余基线支持的只是单图像条件. 对于TRELLIS.2,我们执行多视图模式,在解析时切换调值视图,遵循TRELLIS(Xiang等人,2024年). 为了确保材料生成的公平比较,除了ReconViaGen不能包含几何输入外,所有方法都使用GT几何法;因此,我们只提供ReconViaGen的质量比较. 我们还提出了与行业领先的商业模式的定性比较。

blocks.en: As our method focuses on the generation of complex textures, we select 30 objects with rich textures from TexVerse ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) for quantitative comparisons. We render views on both the conditioning and novel viewpoints of the generated objects to evaluate texture reconstruction and generation performance of all methods. For conditioning views, we report Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS) ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) . For novel views, we report Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , CLIP-based Fréchet Inception Distance (CLIP-FID) ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and CLIP Image Similarity (CLIP-I).
blocks.zh: 由于我们的方法侧重于生成复杂的纹理,我们从TexVerse(张等人,2025年)中选择了30个纹理丰富的物体进行定量比较. 我们对所生成的物体的构造和新观点发表意见,以评价所有方法的纹理重建和生成性能。 对于调节视图,我们报告峰信号对噪比(PSNR),结构相似度指数度量(SSIM)(Wang等人,2004年),以及学习感知图像补丁相似度(LPIPS)(张等人,2018年). 对于新颖的观点,我们报告Fréchet Inception District(FID)(Heusel等人,2017年),基于CLIP的Fréchet Inception District(CLIP-FID)(拉德福德等人,2021年),以及CLIP图像相似性(CLIP-I).

blocks.en: Figure 6: Single-view comparisons. Our method achieves superior reconstruction fidelity, especially on text and patterns, while synthesizing highly coherent textures across unobserved regions.
blocks.zh: 图6:单一观点比较。 我们的方法实现了更好的重建忠心,特别是在文字和图案方面,同时将高度一致的纹理合成在无人观察的区域。

blocks.en: Figure 7: Multi-view comparisons. Given four-view inputs, our method produces accurate, consistent and detailed textures, whereas competing methods yield erroneous and incoherent patterns
blocks.zh: 图7:多视图比较。 鉴于四点意见,我们的方法产生准确、一致和详细的纹理,而相互竞争的方法产生错误和不一致的模式

blocks.en: Figure 8: Comparisons with commercial models. We use the geometry from Rodin Gen2.5 ( Rodin Team, 2026 ) as our geometric input and others use their own geometries. Overall, TaoTex achieves superior performance compared to existing commercial models in fine-grained reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 图8:与商业模型的比较. 我们使用来自Rodin Gen2.5(Rodin Team,2026年)的几何数据作为我们的几何输入,其他人则使用自己的几何数据. 总体而言,与现有的商业模式相比,TaoTex在精细的重建中取得了优异的性能.

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparisons
blocks.zh: 4.1 比较

blocks.en: Quantitative results in Tab. 1 show that our method substantially surpasses all competing methods across metrics, confirming its advantage in material reconstruction and generation. Qualitatively ( Fig. 6 ), our approach faithfully preserves text and pattern details that other baselines fail to resolve. Among the alternatives, TRELLIS.2 ( Xiang et al., 2026 ) yields coherent textures but lacks high-frequency details. UniTEX ( Liang et al., 2026 ) leverages fine-tuned FLUX ( Labs et al., 2025 ) to synthesize multi-view textures, yet suffers from instability and severe texture fragmentation. While Ink3D ( Han et al., 2026 ) and MaterialMVP ( He et al., 2025 ) achieve plausible visual quality, Ink3D suffers from noticeable geometry-appearance misalignment stemming from its video-based orbit synthesis, whereas MaterialMVP struggles to preserve fine-grained texture details, ultimately compromising their quantitative performance.
blocks.zh: Tab 中的量化结果. 1 显示我们的方法大大超越了各种标准的所有相互竞争的方法,证实了它在物质重建和生产方面的优势。 从质量上看(图6),我们的方法忠实地保存了其他基线无法解决的案文和模式细节。 在替代品中,TRELLIS.2(Xiang等人,2026年)产生连贯的纹理,但缺乏高频细节. UniTEX(Liang等人,2026年)利用微调的FLUX(Labs等人,2025年)合成多景纹理,但受到不稳定和严重纹理分裂的影响. 当墨水3D (Han等人,2026年)和MaterialMVP(He等人,2025年)的视觉质量是可信的,Ink3D因基于视频的轨道合成而出现明显的几何出现错位,而MaterialMVP则努力保存精细的纹理细节,最终损害其数量性能.

blocks.en: Our method continues to lead all baselines under multi-view conditioning ( Tab. 2 ). TRELLIS.2 and MaterialMVP produce blurry and incorrect textures when conditioned on multiple views, and they are particularly unable to place textures at the correct locations on cylindrical cans ( Fig. 7 ), where geometric cues are less pronounced. ReconViaGen ( Chang et al., 2026 ) reconstructs geometry and textures using VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025 ) features. While it can generate roughly accurate textures, the results are often blurry and lack fine details. In contrast, benefiting from our well-learned viewpoint embeddings, our method accurately generates text and complex patterns on the correct geometric surfaces while producing sharp and consistent textures.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法继续在多视图调制下引导所有基线(Tab. 2). TRELLIS.2和MaterialMVP在以多视图为条件时会产生模糊和不正确的纹理,它们尤其无法在圆柱形罐子(图7)上的正确位置放置纹理,这些位置的几何提示不太明显. ReconViaGen(张等,2026年)利用VGGT(王等,2025年)特征重建几何和纹理. 虽然它可以产生大致准确的纹理,但结果往往模糊不清,缺乏精细的细节. 与此相反,我们的方法利用我们深入的见解,准确地在正确的几何表面产生文字和复杂的图案,同时产生尖锐和连贯的纹理。

blocks.en: Fig. 8 presents qualitative comparisons with commercial alternatives. In the single-view setting, our method faithfully preserves fine-grained text and patterns (e.g., on product packaging and clothes). In multi-view scenarios, whereas commercial models frequently suffer from texture misalignment and ghosting artifacts on symmetric objects (e.g., medicine bottles and vases), our approach accurately maps multi-view inputs onto corresponding surfaces with seamless transitions. Overall, our method outperforms competing commercial models in texture fidelity, material disentanglement, and generation stability.
blocks.zh: 图8介绍了与商业替代品的质量比较。 在单景设定中,我们的方法忠实地保存了精细的文字和图案(如产品包装和服装). 在多景情景中,虽然商业模型经常在对称对象(如药瓶和花瓶)上出现纹理错位和幽灵化的文物,但我们的方法将多景输入精确地映射到相应的表面,无缝过渡. 总的来说,我们的方法在纹理的忠实、物质的分离和生成稳定性方面超过了相互竞争的商业模式。

blocks.zh: 表3:读取研究. 在多视图输入设置下对所有拼贴进行评估。

blocks.en: 4.2 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.2 阅读研究

blocks.en: The HFT dataset substantially enhances high-frequency details, particularly text patterns. As illustrated in Fig. 4 , training with HFT data allows our model to faithfully recover clear text across curved surfaces. Quantitative results in Tab. 3 further corroborate these gains in detail fidelity, validating both our data construction agent strategy and the effectiveness of the curated data.
blocks.zh: HFT数据集大大提高了高频细节,特别是文本模式. 如图4所示,使用HFT数据的培训可以使我们的模型在曲线表面忠实地恢复清晰的文本。 Tab. 3的量化结果进一步详细证实了这些成果的忠实性,验证了我们的数据构建代理战略和整理数据的有效性。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 compares our fused features with semantic features alone. By aggregating multi-level representations, the fused features from MLFF better preserve fine-grained details from the input images. Without MLFF, the model struggles to reconstruct patterns and text, producing fragmented, blocky, and distorted textures. Coupled with the quantitative results in Tab. 3 , this confirms that the MLFF module effectively enhances texture fidelity.
blocks.zh: 图4 仅用语义特征来比较我们的引信特征。 通过汇总多层次的表示,MLFF的熔化特性更好地保存了输入图像中的精细细节. 没有MLFF,模型会挣扎重建规律和文字,产生零碎,块状,扭曲的纹理. 与 Tab 中的量化结果结合。 3,这证实了MLFF模块有效地增强了纹理的忠诚.

blocks.en: Both Tabs. 3 and 4 demonstrate that introducing the pixel space loss alleviates reconstruction errors from the material SC-VAE, thereby further refining fine details. Without this constraint, optimizing solely in the latent space produces visually plausible textures overall, but tiny text exhibits noticeable distortion (see the zoomed-in views in Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: Tab. 3和4都表明,引入像素空间损失可以减轻材料SC-VAE的重建错误,从而进一步精炼精细的细节. 在没有这种限制的情况下,只在潜在空间进行优化就会产生可看似合理的整体纹理,但微小的文字显示出明显的扭曲(见图4的放大视图)。

blocks.en: The ablation results in Tabs. 3 and 5 validate the efficacy of our viewpoint embeddings and the associated training strategy. Without viewpoint embeddings, the model exhibits spatial ambiguity on nearly symmetric objects with repetitive, intricate patterns (e.g., the vase), often misplacing textures across surface regions. This positional mismatch consequently leads to distorted and fragmented textures (highlighted by the red arrows in Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 减退的结果是 Tabs. 3 和 5 验证了我们的观点嵌入的功效以及相关的培训战略. 在不嵌入观点的情况下,模型在几乎对称的物体上显示出空间模糊性,具有重复性的复杂模式(如花瓶),往往在表层区域错位。 这种位置不匹配导致纹理扭曲和支离破碎(图5中的红箭突出).

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: TaoTex enables high-fidelity native 3D material reconstruction from single- or multi-view inputs via co-designed data, architecture, and training strategies. We leverage a designed data agent to create high-frequency assets, an MLFF module with pixel-space loss to maximize detail preservation, and viewpoint embeddings to ensure accurate multi-view reconstruction. Despite outperforming existing methods, TaoTex remains constrained by voxel resolution when reconstructing minute text or patterns. Since higher resolutions demand prohibitive GPU memory, scaling resolution under a limited memory budget to improve details presents a compelling avenue for future research.
blocks.zh: TaoTex通过共同设计的数据、结构和培训战略,通过单视图或多视图输入,使本地高可靠性的3D材料重建成为可能。 我们利用一个设计的数据代理来创建高频资产,一个具有像素-空域损失的MLFF模块来最大限度地实现细节保存,并视角嵌入以确保准确的多视图重建. 尽管TooTex在现行方法上表现优于其他方法,但在重建分钟文本或图案时仍受到voxel分辨率的限制. 由于更高的分辨率需要令人望而却步的GPU内存,在有限的内存预算下缩放分辨率来改进细节,为今后的研究提供了令人信服的途径.
